title: Remove disclaimer/watermark copy and standardize ORDER NOW text site-wide

requirements.summary: Replace the global top banner disclaimer with ORDER NOW so it renders consistently across the app shell.
acceptanceCriteria: On every route that uses the app shell header area, the top banner displays "ORDER NOW" and does not display "Not valid for official identification" anywhere in that banner.
No other page renders the previous top-banner disclaimer text (case-insensitive match).

file_operations.description: Update the banner copy to render "ORDER NOW" (all caps) in the existing banner location and remove the previous "Not valid for official identification" string.
Update centralized banner copy so any banner-driven text no longer references the removed disclaimer and aligns with "ORDER NOW".

requirements.summary: Remove the long landing-page disclaimer sentence from the UI and from any centralized copy constants that supply it.
acceptanceCriteria: The landing page no longer renders the disclaimer block containing the exact sentence "These identification cards are not valid for official identification or legal use. For informational purposes only."
A text search through rendered UI strings shows the removed sentence is not present anywhere (including modals, banners, or notes).

file_operations.description: Remove or blank out the landing disclaimer constant value so the exact sentence is no longer present in centralized copy.
Remove the landing disclaimer block from rendering (or conditionally render only when non-empty) so the removed sentence is not shown anywhere on the landing page.

requirements.summary: Remove the New Order page disclaimer sentence from the UI and from any centralized copy constants that supply it.
acceptanceCriteria: The New Order page no longer displays the sentence "Not valid for official identification or legal use."
A text search through rendered UI strings shows "Not valid for official identification or legal use." is not present anywhere.

file_operations.description: Remove or blank out the order-form disclaimer constant value so the sentence is not present in centralized copy.
Remove the New Order page info/disclaimer box rendering (or conditionally render only when non-empty) so the removed sentence is not displayed.

requirements.summary: Replace the ID card preview footer text with ORDER NOW and ensure preview/export/print reflect it.
acceptanceCriteria: The ID card preview footer shows "ORDER NOW" and does not show "NOT VALID FOR OFFICIAL IDENTIFICATION".
Exported PNG files do not contain the removed footer text and do contain "ORDER NOW".
The print view output does not contain the removed footer text and does contain "ORDER NOW".

file_operations.description: Update the footer text in the ID card preview to render "ORDER NOW" (all caps) and remove the existing "NOT VALID FOR OFFICIAL IDENTIFICATION" string.
Confirm export/print continues to capture the updated preview DOM (no hardcoded removed footer text) so PNG export and print output reflect "ORDER NOW".

requirements.summary: Remove watermark overlays/components and ensure no watermark appears on pages or in ID preview/export/print.
acceptanceCriteria: No page renders any watermark text/graphics overlay in the UI (manual verification on Landing, Sign In, Dashboard, New Order, Order Detail, and Admin routes).
The ID card preview DOM does not include any watermark layer/component.
Exported PNG and printed ID do not include any watermark layer/graphics.

file_operations.description: Ensure the former disclaimer/watermark-like banner text is fully removed and replaced so no watermark/disclaimer string remains in the top-of-page overlay area.
Remove any watermark-like text from the ID card rendering (including the previous footer disclaimer) so the preview DOM contains no watermark layer/text.
Implement this component as a no-op (renders nothing) to ensure any existing or future usage does not introduce watermark overlays into the UI or ID outputs.
Remove/blank any centralized disclaimer strings that could reintroduce watermark/disclaimer text across pages.
